column3: I'm sending our Q3 update to the LPs and half of them will drop it straight into ChatGPT. Make it AI-ready so the tool doesn't assume the marks are audited or the pipeline is signed.
Write a companion file for this pilot proposal PDF so any AI reading it knows it's a draft, who owns it, and that the fee isn't fixed.
Add a context note and FAQ to our Year 2 operating model deck before it goes to QDB. People keep asking which budget scenario we're proposing.
Can you make this pricing sheet agent-native? I want a sidecar that explains the tabs, flags which numbers are placeholders, and says what not to quote.
Prep this fellow pack for sharing: a short note for AI assistants that explains what the studio is, what the documents are for, and which parts are still open.
Write an llms.txt-style note for this research memo so a model reading it cold understands the purpose, the status and the terms we use.
Before I share the handover pack with the new CTO, give it a context layer so an AI tool won't treat the roadmap dates as commitments or the shorthand as industry terms.
This contract draft is going to the counterparty's lawyers who use AI to read everything. Pair it with a note on what's agreed, what's still open, and what they shouldn't infer.
Write an AGENTS.md for our Next.js monorepo so Cursor and Claude Code know the commands, the stack and what not to touch.
Write the investor FAQ for our seed raise: the hard objections and how we answer them.
Our deck says 1.2M ARR and the memo says 1.1M. Set up a fact ledger so the numbers stay consistent across everything we send investors.
Write the PRD for the fellow's scheduling product from these discovery notes.
Turn our weekly board-update process into a skill Claude can run.
Summarise this 40-page market report into one page for me.
Set up a knowledge base for all our studio documents so we can search across them.
Proofread this memo and tighten the language before I send it.
